say:1:1330918001:1.text: Still no improvement, and the Archduke is worried sick. To ensure the princess gets enough rest, the Archduke has laid out several new rules to maintain silence.
say:1:1330918001:1.source_cn: 还是没见好……大公因此忧心不已。为了让公主殿下能静养，...
say:1:1330918001:1.male: Still no improvement, and the Archduke is worried sick. To ensure the princess gets enough rest, the Archduke has laid out several new rules to maintain silence.
say:1:1330918001:1.female: Still no improvement, and the Archduke is worried sick. To ensure the princess gets enough rest, the Archduke has laid out several new rules to maintain silence.

say:2:1330918002:1.text: Don't break any rules while working; you might infuriate the Archduke.
say:2:1330918002:1.source_cn: 你们在工作的时候也要小心，别触犯了规矩惹得大公生气。
say:2:1330918002:1.male: Don't break any rules while working; you might infuriate the Archduke.
say:2:1330918002:1.female: Don't break any rules while working; you might infuriate the Archduke.
